visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit retail store aisle, specifically the stationery section of BIC CAMERA. Shelves are densely packed with colorful products. A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a black puffer jacket and a pink face mask, stands in the center of the frame. (2) Close-up shot of a display for Zebra Lightwrite pens. A hand reaches in and picks up a sage green pen. The hand presses the top button, causing the tip of the pen to emit a bright white LED light, which is then demonstrated by writing on a small notepad in a shadowed area. (3) Transition to a display of Zebra Blen pens. A hand is shown writing Japanese characters on a clipboard notepad to demonstrate the pen's smooth, stable writing experience. (4) The woman is shown again, holding a very long pair of PLUS brand scissors packaged in yellow and blue. She looks surprised by the length of the tool, pointing at the long blade. (5) A yellow KOKUYO HAKO-AKE tool is shown in its packaging. The back of the package is displayed, showing diagrams of how the tool functions as both a box cutter and scissors. (6) A hand uses a thick TOMBOW Mono Work pencil to quickly shade in circles on an OMR-style examination bubble sheet, demonstrating its efficiency for test-taking. (7) Several unique erasers are showcased: a KOKUYO eraser designed to erase single lines, a Pentel Clic Eraser meant for oil-based ink, and a TOMBOW Mono Natural eraser made from shell materials. (8) The video concludes with a white screen featuring a large QR code and social media icons for various platforms including Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.
